description: For every infinite \(L\)-structure \(M\) and cardinal \(\kappa\), there is an elementary embedding \(M\to N\) with \(|N|\ge\kappa\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.LargerModels.arbitrarily_large_elementary_extension.{u} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u}
  [L.Structure M] [Infinite M] (κ : Cardinal.{u}) : ∃ N, Nonempty (L.ElementaryEmbedding M ↑N) ∧ κ ≤ Cardinal.mk ↑N
